title: Bigger cards and text on the board
author: claude
summary: Made the board's cards and writing about a third bigger so they are easier to read.
what: Cards, sticky notes, titles, summaries, stamps, numbers and arrow labels are all about 1.3 times bigger.
why: The text was too small to read comfortably.
how: Raised the card sizes in board/model.ts (the layout uses them) and the matching font sizes and spacing in board.css.
beforeText: Step cards 270 px wide, 24 px titles, 13.5 px summaries.
afterText: Step cards 360 px wide, 32 px titles, 17 px summaries.
